banner.title: TRR Library
body: A collection of technique research reports (TRR) documenting attack techniques for use in understanding, emulating, and detecting cyber attacks. New to TRRs? Start with the [TRR Guide](https://github.com/tired-labs/techniques/blob/main/docs/TECHNIQUE-RESEARCH-REPORT.md) or read about the initiative's goals in the [Project Overview](https://github.com/tired-labs/techniques/blob/main/docs/PROJECT-OVERVIEW.md).
Browse every report on the [Techniques](techniques.html) page, or see them arranged by tactic on the [Matrix](matrix.html).
